_comment: USD per 1M tokens, matched by substring of the model id (first match wins). Ships empty on purpose: rates change, and a wrong rate is worse than none. Put your own card in the plugin's data directory as prices.json with the same shape; /workflow-retro passes it with --prices. Example row: { "match": "sonnet", "input": 0, "cache_write": 0, "cache_read": 0, "output": 0 }
